boundary.description: From the junction of Hyde Road and Wall Way, N along Debdale Park (west border) and Gorton Lower Reservoir (W, then N border). Then S by Debdale lane to and S along Manchester – Tameside District boundary to the point opposite Clumber Road and by a bee-line E past Wilton Paddock to, and E along Hyde Road. Then S by M60 Motorway to and SW along the Denton - Reddish railway, to the railway junction and then S along the railway to and S along River Tame to the point opposite Lune Way. Then by a beeline SW to and W along Willow Avenue, N along Reddish Road, Birkdale Road, SE along Greg Street, E along Whitehill Street, then N along Manchester Road, Broadstone Road and Nelstrop Road to its junction with Carnforth Road. Then along a footpath to Black Brook and by a beeline to and N along Manchester – Stockport District boundary to Broadfield Road and by a beeline to Bowling Road, Turnbull Road, Brighton Range and Hyde Road to its junction with Wall Way.

internalBoundaries.description: From the Denton – Reddish and Brinnington – Reddish railway junction, W along Brinnington – Reddish railway to Winsmill Lane. NW along Windmill Lane and Longford Road to its junction with Nelstrop Road North.
